onPlayerAction((uint256,address,address,.notice: Zero in-round decisions by design (CUT LIST 12); capabilities.submitAction is false.

onSessionStart((uint256,address,address,.notice: TRAP 3 — in production this is called TWICE: once as a simulation with sessionId == 0 before portfolio commit, then again with the real context. This implementation is a pure function of (wagerBase, gameData) — it reads no session id, no block, no state — so it is idempotent by construction. The local simulator does not reproduce the double call, so this cannot be caught locally.
